approved_scope.title: External artifacts stay machine-local: committed records keep no path (14)
approved_scope.description: External artifacts stay machine-local: committed records keep no path (14)
acceptance_criteria: evidence add and cases record with an absolute artifact path commit only a neutral external:<16 hex> ID and the SHA-256 in the record, never the path, file name, user name or home directory; the path is kept only in the git-ignored .chough/local/external-artifacts.json; on the recording machine a changed file reads stale and an unchanged one current; where the mapping or the file is absent the observation reads external-not-checkable-here, neither current nor historical; evidence prune --apply never removes the external file; docs say outside files verify only on the recording machine.

answers.constraints: Leif's decision on #208, 2026-11-10, relayed by the coordinator (hc t370): 'mark it machine-local.. also don't leak info or creds or pii.. what if my name was there'. Committed records must not contain the external path at all, not even with ~; commit only the fingerprint plus a neutral id; keep the real path in git-ignored machine-local state; show 'external, not checkable here' where the mapping or file is missing; docs say outside files verify only on the recording machine. #234 tracks the general no-leak rule.
